content: VERIFIED from official docs (orm.drizzle.team/docs/migrations, fetched 2026-09-08): drizzle-kit push applies schema diff directly to DB (prototyping-oriented); generate produces migration.sql plus snapshot.json from schema diff; migrate applies unapplied migration files tracked via DB history; pull introspects live DB into TS schema (the supported way to baseline from reality); export emits SQL. Runtime migrate(db) from drizzle-orm/node-postgres/migrator exists for deploy-time application. Implication for Prisma-to-Drizzle cutover: author schema from live DDL via pull or pg_dump, generate an intentional baseline, and add an empty-diff CI gate.
